categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the manufacturing and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs), including rigid PCBs, flexible PCBs (FPC), high-density interconnect (HDI) boards, and IC substrates. Its products serve various applications such as LCD TVs, monitors, notebooks, public information displays, solid-state drives, and automotive electronics. The company also plans to develop new products for high-speed consumer electronics, automotive electronics, display technologies, and wearable devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including chemical etching, electroplating, and multilayer circuit design. It focuses on upgrading high-speed circuit board technologies with low signal loss materials, low dielectric constant (DK) materials, and surface treatments to meet high-frequency and low-latency requirements, especially for AI computing and smart city applications. Automation and intelligent manufacturing are emphasized to improve production efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, servers, networking, and communication devices. Major end markets are Taiwan, China, Singapore, and Hong Kong, with products used in devices such as smartphones, tablets, wearable devices, automotive control boards, and high-performance computing servers. The company serves both domestic and international clients, including major global electronics brands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities in Taiwan, China (including Suzhou, Wuxi, and Suining), Vietnam, and Thailand. Its sales and distribution cover Taiwan, China, Singapore, and Hong Kong primarily, with ongoing expansion efforts in Southeast Asia to diversify production and reduce geopolitical risks. The Vietnam plant was recently commissioned to serve local customers and expand regional presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain as a manufacturer of printed circuit boards, which are essential substrates for electronic components. It sources raw materials such as substrates, copper foil, films, and chemicals from upstream suppliers and supplies PCBs to downstream electronics manufacturers and assemblers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing automation and intelligent manufacturing to address labor shortages and improve quality, expanding product categories and sales channels, and developing high-value-added products such as thin, multilayer, and fine-line PCBs. The company invests in R&D for advanced materials and processes tailored for AI computing, 5G, automotive electronics, and wearable devices. Sustainability initiatives focus on energy efficiency, carbon reduction, and environmental compliance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of various types of printed circuit boards. The company does not engage in subscription or licensing models but focuses on manufacturing and selling PCBs to electronics manufacturers. Sales are conducted both domestically and internationally, with a significant portion of revenue from exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly fragmented global PCB market with numerous domestic and international players. It positions itself by leveraging advanced manufacturing technologies, stable quality, competitive pricing, and diversified product offerings. The company maintains a market share of approximately 0.74% of the global PCB market and faces competition from Chinese PCB manufacturers, which are rapidly growing their global market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$17.7 billion, a 6.47% decline from the previous year, with net profit attributable to the parent company of NT$746 million, down 31.79%. Despite recent revenue contraction due to weak consumer electronics demand and geopolitical risks, the company has a stable asset base of over NT$30 billion and equity of NT$16.5 billion. It is investing in capacity expansion and automation to support moderate growth aligned with industry trends.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological expertise in producing high-quality, high-frequency, and fine-line PCBs tailored for emerging applications such as AI computing, 5G, automotive electronics, and wearable devices. It differentiates through advanced manufacturing processes, automation, and sustainability practices, including energy efficiency and environmental compliance. The company also offers comprehensive customer service with localized production in multiple countries to reduce supply chain risks and improve responsiveness.
